meta.title: Serverless Egress: Four Steps, One Shared Object

views.label: Decide before the landing zone
views.note: This is an architecture decision, not a runtime one — retrofitting it means touching workloads already running.

views.label: One NCC per region
views.note: The NCC is account-level and shared by every attached workspace in that region — its rules are a shared blast radius.

views.label: The step outside Databricks
views.note: Firewall allow-lists are configured by a team that often was never told the migration was happening.

cards.title: Three properties classic networking doesn't have
items: The NCC is account-level, regional, and shared across every attached workspace
A workspace admin cannot create one — it needs an account admin, which is a scheduling dependency, not a technical one
Two target regions means two NCCs with two rule sets to keep consistent

cards.title: Ordering that bites if skipped
items: The target resource must exist before you can point a private endpoint rule at it
Some private endpoints also need approval on the resource side — another team, another elapsed day
Deciding serverless scope after the landing zone means retrofitting egress onto workloads already running

cards.title: The step most likely to be missed
items: Firewall allow-lists live outside Databricks, often owned by a team never told about the migration
Its failure mode is a workload that hangs, not one that errors clearly
Databricks decommissioned the legacy stable-IP list on 25 May 2026 — re-derive it, don't copy an old one
